statement:
The request record gives the access level **administrator of the whole company** for this case.
Access request **AR-3391** resolved. Assigned **read-only** access because the account belongs to an outside partner; company policy prohibits administrator rights.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states the record's admin level is prohibited: "company policy prohibits administrator rights" and gives the correct value, read-only.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
